market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $55,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC's 2026 low so far is ~$60,033 (Feb 2026), and the $55,000 trigger has NOT been hit yet. Currently ~$76,500-$77,000 on April 28, 2026. To resolve Yes, BTC would need a further ~28% drop in 8 months. Given recent volatility and tested $60K floor, this is plausible but not the base case. Estimate ~25-30%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Macro (Fed) and structural crypto risk could drive another flush; current $77K base is well above trigger.
